reveal_en: Scientists estimate that the total biomass of all ants on Earth is approximately equal to the total biomass of all humans. This staggering ecological balance highlights the pervasive yet often overlooked presence of these tiny insects.
reveal_zh: 科学家估计，地球上所有蚂蚁的总生物量与人类总生物量大致相等。这个惊人的生态平衡突显了这些小昆虫无处不在的存在。
meaning_en: This surprising parity reorients our perspective on Earth's dominant life forms, revealing the immense, unseen influence of the natural world.
meaning_zh: 这种出人意料的平等重新定义了我们对地球主导生命形式的看法。

visual.motion: A vast network of tiny, interconnected forms subtly pulsing, representing immense collective life.
